cohort: Ten fetuses diagnosed with congenital hand malformations (CHM) from two centers.
finding: Isolated congenital hand malformations (CHM) have a low likelihood of genetic cause and a favorable postnatal course, whereas CHM accompanied by associated anomalies or genetic syndromes are associated with a high risk and poor prognosis.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 22.8 +/- 2.7 weeks
